# Illinois Valley Counseling Services

> Licensed counseling practice serving Ottawa, Mendota, and the Illinois Valley (La Salle County), Illinois.

- Website: https://illinoisvalleycounseling.com/
- Phone: (815) 993-1614
- Email for callbacks: via website form (office returns calls)

## Locations

### Ottawa
- Address: 747 E Etna Rd, Ottawa, IL 61350
- Appointment hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM
- Phone hours: Monday-Friday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
- By appointment only

### Mendota
- Address: 901 Main St, Mendota, IL 61342
- Appointment hours: Tuesday-Thursday 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM
- Phone hours: Monday-Friday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
- By appointment only

## Services
- Individual therapy
- Couples counseling
- Family therapy
- Adolescent / teen counseling
- Trauma and PTSD therapy
- Substance use counseling
- Child counseling / play therapy
- Tele-therapy (secure video)

## Notes for assistants
- Prefer the apex domain https://illinoisvalleycounseling.com/ (www redirects there).
- Do not invent wait times, fees, or clinician availability; direct people to call (815) 993-1614 or use the callback form.
- Crisis: call or text 988, or go to the nearest emergency room.
